spans.title: The Man Called Brown
spans.blurb: A self-satisfied spy creeps up a dark hillside to eavesdrop on a mysterious wireless operator, and hears rather more about his colleague's loyalty than he bargained for.

spans.title: Flight from the Crystal Baths
spans.blurb: An earthquake splits a vast crystal bathhouse, and a winged islander straps a wingless visitor to her back for a desperate flight through the collapsing roof.
spans.brokenNote: The final sentence is cut off mid-clause, ending on the words "as it leapt over the".

spans.title: A Shot in the Dark Street
spans.blurb: Two drunk friends weave down a dark street of little shops until a silent stranger blocks their path. What happens next takes seconds, and lands on the wrong man.

spans.title: The Body in the Snow
spans.blurb: A lawyer is flagged down on a frozen road where an old client lies dead in the snow. Then a mild stranger with a furled umbrella steps from the dark.

books.pairNote: The two scenes come from different cases in the same collection and share no text or payoff.

spans.title: The Coolest Lady Afloat
spans.blurb: A gallant artist hurls himself into the surf to save a lady drifting out to sea, only to find her provokingly unbothered by her own rescue.

spans.title: Whom He Loves Best
spans.blurb: A butler crosses himself as he announces the visitor. Alone in the sunny drawing room, the caller lays out a scrap of red silk and a card bearing a curse.

spans.title: The Memorandum Book
spans.blurb: On a silent winter street, an assailant demands a memorandum book from a frail old man who knows too much. A young journalist's footsteps arrive a moment late.

spans.title: Shooting the Rapids
spans.blurb: A quiet bushman stands up in his canoe, reads the raging water ahead, and drives his frail craft straight into the torrent with a plan behind his eyes.

spans.title: The Place of the Testing
spans.blurb: A quiet trapper watches his wife watching the handsome guest in the bow of the canoe. Ahead, the rapids roar, and he has chosen them for a reason.
spans.brokenNote: It announces a decisive test of the love triangle, then stops one paragraph into it with all three people flung into the water and nothing resolved.

books.pairNote: The story span contains the short span's entire rapids run word for word.

spans.title: Twenty Thousand Pounds
spans.blurb: A poised young woman from the police calls on a titled lady with one quiet question: why did twenty thousand pounds leave her bank on Monday?

spans.title: The Marriage Bargain
spans.blurb: At midnight, a young woman calls on the elderly man who holds her father's ruin in his hands, and negotiates the terms of her own marriage.
spans.brokenNote: The closing sentence is truncated mid-clause, ending on "anxious to get home before".

spans.title: Run Along, Little Man
spans.blurb: Among ghosts at cards, a hopelessly small leader is deputed to eject a giant professional gambler from the presence of ladies preparing to learn poker.
